project.title: Microbial diversity of domestic washingmachine wastewater
project.description: Sequencing of microbial isolates obtained from domestic laundry greywater. The aim of the project is to assemble a defined microbial consortium, including the nitrogen-fixing cyanobacterium Trichormus sp., for the bioremediation of surfactant- and nutrient-rich laundry effluent. Genome and marker gene data are generated to support taxonomic assignment and functional annotation of the candidate consortium members.
